design: neutral scalar and vector combinational modules
docstring: A connectivity skeleton must schedule real positive-time DUT input transitions before checking combinational output resolvability; declaration initialization alone may precede an always process waiting for input changes.
fix_action: Augment `design_one_shot_runner.step_full_stack_tb_gen` at the generating producer. On its no-resolved-DUT-clock path, use the existing input/role lists to complement ordinary data regs after reset and complement again at a later time, restoring zero before the existing run delay and unchanged output checks. Keep clocked/reset and author-TB behavior intact.
before_state: Valid unchanged combinational RTL compiled and reached DONE but its generated inputs never changed after time zero; the existing output-resolvability checks failed and the existing connectivity reader refused the run.
after_state: The same RTL passes the same connectivity checks after real known-to-different-to-zero input events. A truly undriven output still fails and blocks the reader; clocked TB bytes and all output check sections are preserved.
ai_reasoning: This is a scheduling defect at the TB producer, independent of missing professional expert hooks. Real input events activate the valid combinational process; no output expectation or acceptance threshold needs changing.
pattern: A generated TB initializes inputs only in declarations, while no clock/reset activity reaches a combinational DUT. A valid sensitivity-list process can therefore remain unexecuted and leave outputs X, causing a false connectivity refusal.
generality: Input names, widths and roles come from existing DUT contracts; no benchmark identifier, private design literal, oracle or expected answer selects the behavior.
evidence: CAPTURE.md; red.xml, base.xml, candidate.xml, reverse.xml, restored.xml and parity.json in the named external packet
corpus_sweep: 32 matched owning/nearby tests: 3 improved, 29 unchanged PASS, zero introduced failures; undriven-output, clock/reset, output-direction and author-TB preservation controls retained. No external corpus, benchmark or full suite was run.
